entries.rationale: BEH-5 and its two error-case rows fully specified with exact test/impl code; trivial extension of the already-established formatFetchError helper, no golden sample but strong in-repo precedent.

BEH-6 fully specified with exact required-field list and test/impl code; mirrors the existing validateProjectForm/#create-project shape closely, no curated sample but near-identical in-repo precedent.
BEH-1 fully specified with exact payload/wiring code; mirrors the existing create-project submit-handler pattern, plus a small new module-state variable (currentProjectId).
BEH-2 fully specified, but introduces a genuinely new diffing function, card-click-to-edit interaction, and two new module-state variables with no direct in-repo precedent for any of them.
BEH-3 and its postcondition fully specified, but drag-and-drop plus optimistic-move/revert is a novel interaction pattern in this codebase with no prior HTML5 drag-event precedent.
BEH-4 and its error-case row fully specified with exact code; reuses the removal/render path and confirm-dialog pattern already established for the 404 exception in Tasks 4-5.
